title: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: The idea
scenes.purpose: Set up the opening shape: a whole white paper idea bulb with the title, and the red cut line.
visuals: Navy desk with stationary floor plane
White cut-paper circle with blue paper base
Red slash drawn across the circle

beats.development: Paper bulb drops into place; AN then IDEA hard-cut on.
Red slash draws from top-right to bottom-left through the circle.

scenes.title: The cut
scenes.purpose: One graphic cut reveals the network silhouette hidden inside the idea.
visuals: Lower paper half slides away along the slash
Connections draw across the white half

beats.development: The cut paper half slides off along the slash, exposing the hidden network.
Core lights red, edges spread to a new node; 'becomes a connected' wipes in.

scenes.title: System
scenes.purpose: Land the title and hold it.

beats.development: SYSTEM slab slaps in from the right; case-file line steps on.
Full title and revealed network hold still.

findings: Hard-cut word entrances and a single 0.38 s cut keep the move brisk; all motion settles by 2.34 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.34–3.0 s final title hold for reading, as the style requires one short hold.

notes: Renderer SVG, motion owner one paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video.
